title: Build Intelligent Agents with Work IQ, Foundry IQ, and Fabric IQ
description:
What if your AI agents truly understood how your business works, had instant access to trusted enterprise data, and could take meaningful action from end to end? In this demo-driven session, we’ll cover how to build enterprise-ready AI agents that understand business context, use trusted data, and take real action. In this fast-paced session, we’ll bring Work IQ, Foundry IQ, and Fabric IQ together with Copilot Studio through best practices and live demos.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
